records.title: The Czech National Bank board approves studying a bitcoin reserve — up to 5% floated.
records.text: The Czech National Bank board approves studying a bitcoin reserve — up to 5% floated. Lagarde rejects it publicly the same day: no bitcoin in any EU central-bank reserve. Prague later buys a one-million-dollar test portfolio anyway. The bloc's only central-bank crypto-reserve move, strangled in the crib and still twitching.

records.title: A gold-linked settlement pilot called the Unit launches — 40% gold, 60% BRICS-currency basket, on Cardano, run by a research institute.
records.text: A gold-linked settlement pilot called the Unit launches — 40% gold, 60% BRICS-currency basket, on Cardano, run by a research institute. Headlines call it the BRICS gold currency; no summit ever endorsed it, no member government signed. Filed here because the hype itself is the signal: the world wants to believe a gold settlement layer is coming.
